reason: The expanded tetragonal cell, Z=4, apical-I K2NiF4-type average framework, and preferred Cmme Cl/F ordering family are well supported by indexing and explicit ordering comparisons, but the exact submitted realization is not sufficiently established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, the trajectory's profile fit remained Rp-like about 0.295, and only the Rb/I z coordinates plus a common intensity-attenuation term were refined; ideal in-plane coordinates were imposed, giving equal approximately 2.46 A Cr-F and Cr-Cl distances. A chemically motivated bond-length-relaxed/lower-symmetry realization was not instantiated or compared and could plausibly improve the candidate set, so another solution attempt is warranted.
